QuestInfo.name: [Attack on Titan] Maple's Potatoes
QuestInfo.0: Ask K how to get some food.
QuestInfo.1:
C suggested bringing back potatoes that you can get from Maple World monsters. Hunt those monsters to feed the hungry child.

*Potatoes do not drop from monsters 11 levels lower or 21 levels higher than you.
*Have the Maple World <Potato> items in your Inventory when you return to the Subspace Crevasse and it will change to Other World <Potato>.
QuestInfo.2: You brought potatoes over from Maple World to feed the child. He was so thrilled to have food!

npc.0: Hunt monsters in Maple World and collect 50 potatoes to feed the hungry kid.
